title: Claiborne Pell, Jack Reed and Biden: a UFO lineage

tellings.quote: Claybourne Pel was this senator who was long into UFOs who's from Delaware.

plain: Michels traces a line of interest in UFOs through the US Senate, starting with Claiborne Pell, a senator he says was long into UFOs and places in Delaware. He links Pell to Jack Reed, a senator from Rhode Island on the Senate Armed Services Committee, and to Joe Biden. Michels draws the line himself, without naming a source, and it suggests UFO interest passed quietly between powerful politicians.
